notes: Chapter 2 (PRA Definitions) snapshot exposed 75 per-section leaves. Narrowed to definitions widely cross-referenced from Ch. 6 lobbying provisions using project priors about the Political Reform Act. A direct-API run with section-text retrieval could refine this list.
